findings.title: Watering requests have no timeout: a hung 'Water now' spins forever
findings.where: /beds (Water now, Save watering); also /waterings delete and list fetches
findings.steps: On /beds, make POST /api/waterings hang (never answer), then click 'Water now' on a bed and wait more than 10 s.
findings.expected: The request is abandoned after 10 s, an error is shown and the button works again.
findings.actual: After 12 s the button still says 'Watering…' and stays disabled. There is no error and no way to cancel.
findings.evidence: Playwright route delayed the POST by 15 s. Bed card text at 12 s: 'Watering… North bed'. The useApiClient $fetch.create has no timeout option.

findings.title: Double click on 'Water now' records two waterings
findings.steps: On /beds, click 'Water now' twice quickly (two click events before the next render).
findings.actual: Two POSTs go out and two identical waterings are stored. Nothing on the request (such as an idempotency key) and nothing on the server prevents duplicates, so retrying after a timeout also duplicates.
findings.evidence: The route counter saw 2 POSTs. GET /api/waterings then returned ids 4 and 5, both North bed at 2026-11-12 17:52:58.

findings.title: Huge bed_id makes the waterings API answer 500
findings.steps: POST {"bed_id":9223372036854775808} (or 99999999999999999999) to /api/waterings. Or GET /api/waterings?bed_id=9223372036854775808. Or DELETE /api/waterings/9223372036854775808.
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error, because SQLite overflows on an integer that does not fit in 64 bits. /waterings?bed=9223372036854775808 in the UI therefore shows a generic 'Could not load waterings.'
findings.evidence: curl gave 'Internal Server Error 500' for all three requests.

findings.title: Recent waterings error on the dashboard and the waterings page error have no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings fail (500, or HTML 503), then open the dashboard through the nav, or go to /waterings through the 'All waterings' link.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that loads the data again once the server is back.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load recent waterings.' / 'Could not load waterings.' is shown, with no retry control. The dashboard does not even keep the refresh function for waterings, so the user has to reload the page.
findings.evidence: Dashboard section text: 'Recent waterings / All waterings / Could not load recent waterings.' Waterings page: 'Could not load waterings.' with no button.

findings.title: Watering tables overflow 375 px with a long bed name
findings.steps: Create a bed with a 60-character name without spaces (the maximum the API allows), record a watering for it, and view /waterings and / at 375 px width.
findings.expected: No sideways scrolling; long names wrap.
findings.actual: The page scrolls sideways: document scrollWidth is 874 px on /waterings and 788 px on the dashboard. The Bed and Amount columns are pushed off screen. /plants and /tasks stay at 375 px.
findings.evidence: scrollWidth measurements. Overflowing elements are TH 'Bed' (right edge 697 px), TH 'Amount' (788 px) and TD 'North bed'.

findings.title: Very small litres are accepted and shown as '0 L'
findings.expected: A minimum is enforced (such as the form's min of 0.1), or the value is shown faithfully.
findings.actual: The API stores it (201) and the tables show '0 L'.
findings.evidence: The response had litres 1e-300 and the table row read 'North bed  0 L'.

findings.title: Malformed bed filter in the URL shows a raw validation message
findings.expected: The invalid filter is ignored or a friendly message is shown.
findings.actual: The page shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'. The bed select is blank.

findings.title: Retried delete after a timeout reports 'Watering not found' and keeps the stale row
findings.steps: Delete a watering whose request succeeds on the server but times out or fails on the client (or that was already deleted in another tab), then click Delete again.
findings.expected: The second delete is treated as done (idempotent) and the list refreshes.
findings.actual: The DELETE answers 404, the page shows an error, and the list is only refreshed on success, so the row stays visible.
findings.evidence: delete_watering raises not_found when the row is missing. removeWatering calls refresh() only in the try branch.

findings.title: 'Water now' date and the future-date check use the server's time zone, not the gardener's
findings.steps: Use a browser in a time zone ahead of the server, after midnight local time: pick today's date (the form's max is the browser's today) and save, or click Water now.
findings.expected: Today's date is accepted, and the recorded day matches the time shown.
findings.actual: The server checks the date against its own date.today() and rejects 'today' as 'Watering date cannot be in the future.' Water now stores watered_on in server-local time while the time is shown in the viewer's zone, so the entry can show a time on a different day and sort out of order.
findings.evidence: WateringIn.not_in_future uses date.today(). create_watering uses now.astimezone().date(). The frontend todayIso() uses the browser's local date.
